description: This file contains SQL function definitions for managing application tenant context in a multi-tenant database environment. It provides helper functions to set and clear the tenant context for Row Level Security (RLS) implementation.

methods.name: set_app_tenant
methods.description: Sets the tenant context for the current transaction by updating the 'app.current_tenant' configuration parameter.

methods.name: clear_app_tenant
methods.description: Clears the tenant context by resetting the 'app.current_tenant' configuration parameter.
